episodeTitle.en: Making an impact through authenticity and curiosity | Ami Vora (CPO at Faire, ex-WhatsApp, FB, IG)
episodeTitle.zh: 通过真实与好奇心产生影响 | 阿米·沃拉（Faire首席产品官，前WhatsApp、Facebook、Instagram高管）

guestBioOfficial.en: Ami Vora is the Chief Product Officer of Faire, which connects independent retailers and brands around the world. Before Faire, Ami spent over 15 years at Meta, including as VP of Product and Design for WhatsApp (2B+ users), VP of Product for Facebook’s ads system (now $130B of annual revenue), and director at Instagram. She began her career working on developer tools at Microsoft. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why execution eats strategy for breakfast
guestBioOfficial.zh:
阿米·沃拉是Faire的首席产品官，该平台连接全球独立零售商和品牌。在加入Faire之前，阿米在Meta工作了超过15年，曾担任WhatsApp产品与设计副总裁（用户超过20亿）、Facebook广告系统副总裁（年营收现已达1300亿美元）以及Instagram的总监。她职业生涯的开端是在微软开发者工具部门工作。在我们的对谈中，我们将探讨：  
• 执行为何会把战略当早餐吃掉

title.en: Making an impact through authenticity and curiosity | Ami Vora (CPO at Faire, ex-WhatsApp, FB, IG)
title.zh: 通过真实与好奇心产生影响 | 阿米·沃拉（Faire首席产品官，前WhatsApp、Facebook、Instagram高管）

summary.en: Ami discusses the skill of disagreeing skillfully—subordinating your ego to get to the best outcome—and using metaphors and imagery to rally a team around a shared feeling. She introduces the “hill climb” metaphor to distinguish local from global optima and what sustains you through the valley. The conversation covers building strategy skills, being a successful woman in tech, and setting up effective goals, plus a fun lightning round.
summary.zh: Ami 探讨了“优雅地异议”这门艺术——把自我收起来，只为达成最好的结果——以及用隐喻和意象让团队围绕共同感受团结一致。她提出“爬山”隐喻来区分局部最优与全局最优，以及是什么支撑你穿越低谷。对话涵盖策略能力、身为科技行业女性的成功之道、设定有效目标，以及一轮有趣的快问快答。
